resources.string: Widget unlock refresh and background activity
Keep a persistent notification to maintain the unlock listener and request updates for all widgets. When disabled, unlock events can still be received while the app process is alive.

Optional: after enabling the foreground service, enable a transparent overlay to improve background reliability. Requires overlay permission and may show a system overlay notification. Return here and enable it after granting permission.

Allow auto-start and background activity in system settings. Reliability depends on the device; immediate updates after every unlock cannot be guaranteed. Reopen the app after a force stop. Non-root Shizuku usually needs restarting after a device reboot.
Allow notifications before enabling the foreground service.
Shizuku: disconnected; install and start it first
